title: Rankin--Selberg Subconvexity via Spectral Reciprocity
summary: We establish explicit subconvex bounds for central values of Rankin--Selberg $L$-functions $L(1/2,π\timesπ')$ associated with pairs of unitary cuspidal automorphic representations of $\mathrm{GL}_2$ over a number field. Building on the spectral reciprocity framework of Michel and Venkatesh, we develop a refined, fully explicit form of spectral reciprocity that allows for precise control of conductors and local test vectors.
